map.Shahid Enterprizes sells industrial belt: Shahid Enterprizes sells industrial belts, where buyers usually want to talk before they buy. We ran three Meta campaigns, and two of them were built to start messaging conversations.
map.The two conversation campaigns produced: The two conversation campaigns produced 68 and 83 conversations, 151 in total, at PKR 22.04 and PKR 30.14 each. The third was a WhatsApp link campaign built for clicks: 2,813 clicks at PKR 0.67 each. A cost of PKR 0.67 per click and a cost of PKR 22 per conversation measure different things, so putting them in one chart would mislead.
